pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Meridian Law Group is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A sharp glass-walled boardroom set for a strategy session

children: Meridian was founded on a simple frustration: capable companies were paying big-firm rates for counsel run by the least experienced people in the building. We do it the other way around — partners on the work, lean teams, and fees you agree to before we begin.

We advise founders, operators and boards across corporate transactions, commercial litigation, employment and intellectual property. The common thread is judgment under pressure, when the outcome matters and the timeline is short.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every matter starts with a scoped plan — what we’ll do, what it costs and the outcomes we’re aiming at. You decide with the numbers in front of you.
Positioned to win, ready to settle
We prepare every dispute as if it’s going the distance. That posture is exactly what resolves most of them on your terms, faster.
You get a direct line to the attorney handling your work. No gatekeeping, no waiting a week to hear back on a live deal.
